page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable markdown config blocks. Bound to agents with order + enable state.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill or import one from a .md / .zip file. Skills are text-only configuration — never executed.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to edit its markdown body.

card.agentCount: {count, plural, =0 {0 agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}
card.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}" and all of its versions? Agents using it lose it immediately. This cannot be undone.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a reusable markdown block agents can bind and enable.
create.defaultBody:
# Rule

Describe what the reviewing agent should check.

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionHint: Directive interface — agents and catalogs use this to decide when the skill applies.
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag tests that only exercise the success path

detail.loadErrorBody: The skill could not be loaded.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.bodyHint: The only text sent to the model. Editing the body is the entire skill — everything else is metadata.
config.snapshotHint: Saving snapshots the body as v{version}
config.dangerBody: Removes it from all agents. This can't be undone.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.empty: This skill has no body yet.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body so past runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version} as a new current version?

stats.title: Stats
stats.attributionHint: Findings from runs where this skill was in the prompt
stats.loadError: Could not load stats for this skill.
stats.emptyBody: This skill isn't enabled on any agent. Add it to an agent to start collecting stats.

drawer.title: Import skill from file
drawer.subtitle: Upload a .md or .zip (root SKILL.md). Content is stored as data — never executed.
drawer.trustNote: Foreign skill content becomes instructions in the agent prompt. Review the body before enabling.

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.
